WhyShop.title: Why shop on Tern
WhyShop.body: Compare cheapest fares, fastest trips, earliest arrivals, AI-balanced picks, smart connection deals, and delay-risk signals—then book with points or cash in one flow.
WhyShop.disclaimer: Delay risk is an on-device heuristic (connections, redeyes)—not live ATC data. Always confirm at the airline on day of travel.

Hero.title: Chase the horizon.
Hero.subtitle: We compare cheapest, fastest, lowest delay-risk, and best-value-with-points fares side by side, every search.

Checkout.duffelHandoff: Payment and ticketing are handled by our secure checkout partner, Duffel. Your selection doesn't carry over automatically — on the next page, search <route>{from} → {to}</route> again and re-select your flight:
Checkout.aroundPriceSuffix: — final price is shown at checkout
Checkout.testModeNotice: 🧪 Test mode — this demo checkout accepts test cards only and issues no real tickets.
Checkout.checkoutOpenError: Couldn't open the secure checkout. Please try again.
Checkout.whiteLabelHandoff: Or book through our booking site, book.flytern.site: the link below opens it with <route>{from} → {to}</route> and your dates pre-filled — you'll re-select your flight there, and prices may differ. Tern earns a commission on bookings made there, at no extra cost to you.
